consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of the git commands the merge gate runs (the prefix, the NUL-separated name list, the merge base and the ls-tree presence probe), captured 2026-09-29 by the M6-P2 implementer against the repository test/merge-preconditions.test.ts stages in stageShrinkRepo, which re-runs every command and compares git's live output with the recorded stdout. The named test reads the committed verdicts and kernel review records through the same git-backed corpus source on a repository it stages and commits itself.
